svg.aria-label: The path: one lane per row of the set, against time, with a now line at September 20, 2026. A ship-fence band under the axis reads LIFTED on September 20 — the W3 floor is Done and W4's first cut landed, so children may open implementation pull requests, not only specs. Two input lanes from other epics carry bars that reach the now line: the W3 floor FIX-1351, landed, giving seats, channels and skills on disk; and the W4 first cut FIX-1407, landed, giving boards, inventory and dispatch policy, with two strays still in backlog that are not part of the first cut. Then the five lanes of the set, none of which has started, so each is drawn as a dashed line with no bar rather than a zero-width rectangle. FIX-1429, serving the file-declared demo, opens at the now line and is the shortest lane; it is a bug on the direct route with no spec gate. FIX-1475, durable hire, does not open until FIX-1429 closes, so its dashed line begins to the right of the others. FIX-1476, channels and boards, opens at the now line. FIX-1477, the UI package split, opens at the now line and runs longest, because it absorbs the other rows' surfaces as they land rather than waiting for them. FIX-1478, the patterns shed, opens at the now line and is the shortest of the three independents. The critical path is drawn in the gutter as two linked dots on FIX-1429 and FIX-1475, the only hard chain in the set. Under a divider, three related lanes that are not in the set: the parked channel-admin capability FIX-1415, the manager-queue lab FIX-1430 consumed as a POC spine, and org-never-optional FIX-1442, soft-related. A final note records five stale kitchen-sink tickets held pending the owner's triage.
